text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) capital budget variance for the nine months ended on September 30, 2018. As of September 30, 2018, TPH spent $2.305 million representing 50.4 percent of the 2018 Approved Capital Budget of $4.575 million. As of December 31, 2018, TPH is projected to spend $3.745 million representing 81.9 percent of the approved 2018 Capital Budget.
The Board of Health received the report (October 30, 2018) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
